google_service_credentials.description: Absolute path to a Google Cloud credentials JSON file

service_account_email.description: Account email associated to the service.

service_account_secret.description: Private key content associated with the service account.

location.description: The GCP or AWS region in which to store data about the resource.

namespace.description: A namespace identifier, such as a cluster name or environment.

node_id.description: A unique identifier for the node within the namespace, such as hostname or IP address.

job.description: An identifier for a grouping of related task, such as the name of a microservice or distributed batch.

task_id.description: A unique identifier for the task within the namespace and job, such as a replica index identifying the task within the job.

export_to_project_id.description: The GCP project that should receive these logs.
export_to_project_id.default: Defaults to the project ID of the google\_service\_credentials file, or the project\_id from Google's metadata.google.internal server.

k8s_cluster_name.description: The name of the cluster that the container (node or pod based on the resource type) is running in.

k8s_cluster_location.description: The physical location of the cluster that contains (node or pod based on the resource type) the container.

labels_key.description: The value of this field is used by the Stackdriver output plugin to find the related labels from jsonPayload and then extract the value of it to set the LogEntry Labels.
labels_key.default: logging.googleapis.com/labels`. See [Stackdriver Special Fields](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit-docs/blob/master/pipeline/outputs/stackdriver_special_fields.md#log-entry-fields) for more info.

labels.description: Optional list of comma separated of strings specifying key=value pairs.

log_name_key.description: The value of this field is used by the Stackdriver output plugin to extract logName from jsonPayload and set the logName field.
log_name_key.default: logging.googleapis.com/logName`. See [Stackdriver Special Fields](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit-docs/blob/master/pipeline/outputs/stackdriver_special_fields.md#log-entry-fields) for more info.

tag_prefix.description: Set the tag_prefix used to validate the tag of logs with k8s resource type.

severity_key.description: Specify the name of the key from the original record that contains the severity information.
severity_key.default: logging.googleapis.com/severity`. See [Stackdriver Special Fields](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit-docs/blob/master/pipeline/outputs/stackdriver_special_fields.md#log-entry-fields) for more info.

project_id_key.description: The value of this field is used by the Stackdriver output plugin to find the gcp project id from jsonPayload and then extract the value of it to set the PROJECT_ID within LogEntry logName, which controls the gcp project that should receive these logs.
project_id_key.default: logging.googleapis.com/projectId`. See [Stackdriver Special Fields](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-bit-docs/blob/master/pipeline/outputs/stackdriver_special_fields.md#log-entry-fields) for more info.

autoformat_stackdriver_trace.description: Rewrite the trace field to include the projectID and format it for use with Cloud Trace.

workers.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

custom_k8s_regex.description: Set a custom regex to extract field like pod_name, namespace_name, container_name and docker_id from the local_resource_id in logs.

resource_labels.description: An optional list of comma separated strings specifying resource labels plaintext assignments (new=value) and/or mappings from an original field in the log entry to a destination field (destination=$original).

cloud_logging_base_url.description: Set the base Cloud Logging API URL to use for the /v2/entries:write API request.

match.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

match_regex.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
